description:
Get a note's profile (family, description, origin, extraction method) and top fragrances featuring it, sorted by community score. Use the note slug, e.g. 'oud', 'bergamot', 'iris'.

See also: `notes_list` to browse all notes by family/popularity · `fragrance_search` with the `note` filter to find fragrances featuring this note.
